'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Tomashewski DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Effect Wars? (note question mark)
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
